providerStates.name: người dùng đã đăng nhập vào workspace

body.query:
query GetCurrentUser {
  currentUser {
    ...UserQueryFragment
    __typename
  }
}

fragment WorkspaceMemberQueryFragment on WorkspaceMember {
  id
  name {
    firstName
    lastName
    __typename
  }
  colorScheme
  uiScale
  openRecordIn
  avatarUrl
  locale
  userEmail
  userId
  userWorkspaceId
  timeZone
  dateFormat
  timeFormat
  calendarStartDay
  numberFormat
  __typename
}

fragment PartialWorkspaceMemberQueryFragment on WorkspaceMember {
  id
  name {
    firstName
    lastName
    __typename
  }
  avatarUrl
  userEmail
  userId
  userWorkspaceId
  __typename
}

fragment DeletedWorkspaceMemberQueryFragment on DeletedWorkspaceMember {
  id
  name {
    firstName
    lastName
    __typename
  }
  avatarUrl
  userEmail
  __typename
}

fragment ObjectPermissionFragment on ObjectPermission {
  objectMetadataId
  canReadObjectRecords
  canUpdateObjectRecords
  canSoftDeleteObjectRecords
  canDestroyObjectRecords
  restrictedFields
  __typename
}

fragment RowLevelPermissionPredicateFragment on RowLevelPermissionPredicate {
  id
  fieldMetadataId
  objectMetadataId
  operand
  subFieldName
  workspaceMemberFieldMetadataId
  workspaceMemberSubFieldName
  rowLevelPermissionPredicateGroupId
  positionInRowLevelPermissionPredicateGroup
  roleId
  value
  __typename
}

fragment RowLevelPermissionPredicateGroupFragment on RowLevelPermissionPredicateGroup {
  id
  parentRowLevelPermissionPredicateGroupId
  logicalOperator
  positionInRowLevelPermissionPredicateGroup
  roleId
  objectMetadataId
  __typename
}

fragment WorkspaceUrlsFragment on WorkspaceUrls {
  subdomainUrl
  customUrl
  __typename
}

fragment BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseItemFragment on BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseItem {
  price
  quantity
  __typename
}

fragment BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseFragment on BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhase {
  start_date
  end_date
  items {
    ...BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseItemFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment CurrentBillingSubscriptionFragment on BillingSubscription {
  id
  status
  interval
  metadata
  currentPeriodEnd
  cancelAt
  phases {
    ...BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseFragment
    __typename
  }
  billingSubscriptionItems {
    id
    hasReachedCurrentPeriodCap
    quantity
    stripePriceId
    unitAmount
    creditAmount
    billingProduct {
      name
      description
      images
      metadata {
        productKey
        planKey
        priceUsageBased
        isLegacy
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment BillingSubscriptionFragment on BillingSubscription {
  id
  status
  metadata
  cancelAt
  phases {
    ...BillingSubscriptionSchedulePhaseFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment RoleFragment on Role {
  id
  label
  description
  icon
  canUpdateAllSettings
  canAccessAllTools
  isEditable
  canReadAllObjectRecords
  canUpdateAllObjectRecords
  canSoftDeleteAllObjectRecords
  canDestroyAllObjectRecords
  canBeAssignedToUsers
  canBeAssignedToAgents
  canBeAssignedToApiKeys
  __typename
}

fragment AvailableWorkspaceFragment on AvailableWorkspace {
  id
  displayName
  loginToken
  inviteHash
  personalInviteToken
  workspaceUrls {
    subdomainUrl
    customUrl
    __typename
  }
  logo
  sso {
    type
    id
    issuer
    name
    status
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment AvailableWorkspacesFragment on AvailableWorkspaces {
  availableWorkspacesForSignIn {
    ...AvailableWorkspaceFragment
    __typename
  }
  availableWorkspacesForSignUp {
    ...AvailableWorkspaceFragment
    __typename
  }
  __typename
}

fragment UserQueryFragment on User {
  id
  firstName
  lastName
  email
  hasPassword
  canAccessFullAdminPanel
  canImpersonate
  supportUserHash
  onboardingStatus
  previousOnboardingStatus
  isWorkspaceCreator
  workspaceMember {
    ...WorkspaceMemberQueryFragment
    __typename
  }
  workspaceMembers {
    ...PartialWorkspaceMemberQueryFragment
    __typename
  }
  deletedWorkspaceMembers {
    ...DeletedWorkspaceMemberQueryFragment
    __typename
  }
  currentUserWorkspace {
    id
    permissionFlags
    isImpersonating
    objectsPermissions {
      ...ObjectPermissionFragment
      rowLevelPermissionPredicates {
        ...RowLevelPermissionPredicateFragment
        __typename
      }
      rowLevelPermissionPredicateGroups {
        ...RowLevelPermissionPredicateGroupFragment
        __typename
      }
      __typename
    }
    twoFactorAuthenticationMethodSummary {
      twoFactorAuthenticationMethodId
      status
      strategy
      __typename
    }
    __typename
  }
  currentWorkspace {
    id
    displayName
    logo
    inviteHash
    allowImpersonation
    activationStatus
    isPublicInviteLinkEnabled
    isCampaignClickTrackingEnabled
    workspaceDiscoverability
    isGoogleAuthEnabled
    isMicrosoftAuthEnabled
    isPasswordAuthEnabled
    isGoogleAuthBypassEnabled
    isMicrosoftAuthBypassEnabled
    isPasswordAuthBypassEnabled
    subdomain
    customDomain
    hasValidSignedEnterpriseKey
    hasValidEnterpriseValidityToken
    workspaceCustomApplication {
      id
      __typename
    }
    installedApplications {
      id
      name
      universalIdentifier
      logoUrl
      __typename
    }
    isCustomDomainEnabled
    workspaceUrls {
      ...WorkspaceUrlsFragment
      __typename
    }
    featureFlags {
      key
      value
      __typename
    }
    currentBillingSubscription {
      ...CurrentBillingSubscriptionFragment
      __typename
    }
    billingCustomer {
      id
      hasPaymentMethod
      __typename
    }
    billingSubscriptions {
      ...BillingSubscriptionFragment
      __typename
    }
    billingEntitlements {
      key
      value
      __typename
    }
    workspaceMembersCount
    defaultRole {
      ...RoleFragment
      __typename
    }
    aiChatModelTier
    aiAgentModelTier
    isAutoModelSelectionEnabled
    aiModelIdByTier
    aiAdditionalInstructions
    isTwoFactorAuthenticationEnforced
    trashRetentionDays
    eventLogRetentionDays
    editableProfileFields
    isInternalMessagesImportEnabled
    __typename
  }
  availableWorkspaces {
    ...AvailableWorkspacesFragment
    __typename
  }
  userVars
  __typename
}
